_doc: Lulla 1-HOUR bedtime compilation — calendar row C1, planned 2026-08-10.
Built by: python3 scripts/assemble_compilation.py --channel pip-moonlit-garden \
--spec channels/pip-moonlit-garden/comp/60min_calm.json \
--out  channels/pip-moonlit-garden/renders/comp_60min_calm.mp4
THE BINDING RULE: every one of the six published songs appears exactly ONCE and
UNMODIFIED. The `video` paths below are the files that were actually uploaded to
YouTube (the muxed masters, NOT the *_breathe / *_silent intermediates, which are
video-only Ken-Burns passes with no audio stream at all). Song #06 is the one
exception in form only: its published master song06_final.mp4 has the branded
intro+outro concatenated onto it, and six intro stings inside one continuous hour
would be absurd — so the compilation binds song06_lyrics.mp4, which IS that
episode's published body byte-for-byte, and supplies the bookends once, at the
top and tail of the hour, via add_bookends.py.
RUNNING ORDER is a wind-down. scripts/song_energy.py measured all six
(comp/energy.json) and its real finding was that they are near-uniform: the
ranking reshuffles completely when the octave-ambiguous tempo term is dropped
(song06 moves 5th -> 2nd), and the tempo-free spread is only 0.41-0.58. So the
measurement is used where it IS stable — song05 ranks most-animated on BOTH
rankings and opens; song04 has by far the darkest spectrum (1096 Hz centroid vs
1366-1650 for the rest) and sits late — and lyric FUNCTION breaks the many ties:
count -> name colours -> say goodnight -> say goodnight to everything -> breathe
-> be tucked in. That arc is what a half-asleep listener actually experiences.
DURATION BUDGET (all figures measured with ffprobe, not estimated):
six song bodies                                        984.54 s
nine interludes (actual, after internal still xfades)  2651.00 s
minus 14 joins on the 2.5->5.0s crossfade ramp          -52.50 s
= raw compilation                                      3583.04 s
+ add_bookends.py concat (intro 8 + outro 10, no xfade)  +18.00 s
Each interlude's `duration` here is a REQUEST. build_interlude() crossfades the
stills inside the interlude by min(1.0, per/3)s each, so the delivered clip comes
out (n_stills - 1) seconds shorter than requested — the requests below are
pre-compensated by exactly that, which is why they are 212/235/258 (3 stills) and
279..360 (2 stills) rather than round numbers.

segments._note: #2 Count the Fireflies — 160.92s. Counting is an ACTIVITY: cognitively the most activating of the six, and its LRA (9.7) is the second widest. Opens the hour.
#5 Sleepy Little Colors — 158.88s. Ranks MOST animated on both the with-tempo (0.649) and tempo-free (0.580) rankings; the one robust measurement in the set.
#1 Little Light, Goodnight — 158.37s. The first goodnight of the hour.
#3 Goodnight, Little Garden — 158.37s. Goodnight widens from self to the whole world.
#4 Breathe with Lulla — 200.00s, the longest. Body downregulation, and the darkest spectrum in the set (1096 Hz centroid) — the measurement agrees it belongs late.
#6 Time for Bed, Little Light — 148.00s. The tuck-in ritual and the channel's current quality bar; the last words anyone hears in the hour.
